{
  "Select": ["substrate_name","substrate_smiles","parent_name","parent_smiles","met_conversion","pathway_key","enzyme_name"],
  "Source": ["metabolism","molecule_dictionary","compound_structures"],
  "Join": [
    "m LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary cd_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cd_sub.molregno",
    "cd_sub LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON cd_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno",
    "m LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary cd_met ON m.metabolite_record_id = cd_met.molregno",
    "cd_met LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_met ON cd_met.molregno = cs_met.molregno"
  ],
  "Filter": "m.organism = 'Callithrix jacchus'",
  "Sort": "m.met_id ASC",
  "Limit": 200
}
